337: (6) To sweep the house: As he moves dirt from its place. It is also [because] he evens out the holes [in the floor] while he is brooming, since the holes in the house become filled with the dirt, and that is [considered] building. And that is even though he does not have the intention to even out holes — it is nevertheless forbidden, as it is an inevitable consequence [pesik reisha]. And some say that we are concerned lest, as a result of his preoccupation with brooming and tidying up the floor, he will forget and even out the holes on purpose.
